enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the legs. Turn the head to the side of the pillow. Keep eyes closed. Remain lying still on the mattress. Turn the body to the other side. At intervals reach one hand out and pull the sheet back. The fan runs continuously at the bedside, oscillating over the bed throughout the night.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs over the edge. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach for the light switch. Press the switch to turn on the light. Turn the shower tap to the cool setting. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Rub soap over the arms and shoulders. Rinse the body under the running water. Turn off the shower tap. Step out. Pick up the towel. Wipe the head, face and body. Turn on the basin tap. Cup water in both hands. Wet the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth up and down. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the basin. Turn off the tap. Wipe the face with the towel again. Hang the towel on the rail. Press the light switch to turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, toasting bread and boiling the kettle for tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch to turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and the milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place two slices of bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Close the lid of the kettle. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch down. Take a plate from the cupboard. Take a mug from the cupboard. Open the cutlery drawer. Take out a knife. Close the drawer. The toaster pops up the bread. Pick up the toast with the fingers. Put the toast on the plate. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the butter. Close the refrigerator door. Spread butter on the toast with the knife. Pour milk from the carton into the mug. The kettle switches off. Pour hot water from the kettle into the mug. Pick up the mug. Sit on the chair at the table. Lift the toast to the mouth. Bite and chew. Drink from the mug. Finish the toast. Drink the remaining tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Place them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing a bag and checking phone messages about today's community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt and trousers. Lay them on the bed. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Zip up the trousers. Open the drawer. Take out socks. Sit on the bed. Pull the socks onto the feet. Put on the shoes. Tie the laces. Stand up. Pick up the shoulder bag from the chair. Open the bag zip. Place a notebook in the bag. Place a pen in the bag. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the power button to wake the screen. Scroll through the message list with the thumb. Tap open a message from the partner organization. Read the message. Type a short reply with both thumbs. Send the reply. Check the program schedule in the calendar app. Lock the screen. Place the phone in the trouser pocket. Check the fan switch and turn the fan off. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community center for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the door. Open the door. Step outside. Close and lock the door behind. Walk down the path to the street. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the phone. Put the phone back in the pocket. Step onto the arriving bus. Take out the transit card. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Look out of the window. At the stop, stand up. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk two blocks along the pavement to the community center. Push open the entrance door. Walk to the staff area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator, running intake, preparing session materials and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk. Open the laptop. Type the password to log in. Open the intake spreadsheet. Pick up the pen. Write down the names and contact details of arriving participants on the intake form. Stand up. Walk to the entrance. Greet each arriving participant. Say 'Good morning, please sign in here.' Hand the sign-in sheet and pen to the participant. Take back the completed sheet. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Enter the sign-in data into the spreadsheet. Open the printer drawer. Take out printed handouts. Count the handouts and stack them. Walk to the meeting room. Place the handouts on each chair. Rearrange the chairs into a circle. Carry flip chart paper to the room. Tape the flip chart paper to the wall. Pick up the marker. Write the session title on the paper. Walk back to the desk. Open the email inbox. Read messages from partner organizations. Type a reply to a partner. Send the reply. Make a phone call to a partner organization. Say 'We can confirm the workshop at 2 pm.' End the call. Open the supply cabinet. Take out name badges. Carry the badges to the meeting room. Sort the badges on the table. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Continue updating the intake records in the spreadsheet.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the community center, eating and resting in the shade
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Take the lunch box out of the bag. Walk to the courtyard. Sit on the bench in the shade. Open the lid of the lunch box. Pick up the fork. Lift food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the bottle. Close the lid of the lunch box. Place the lunch box on the bench. Lean back on the bench. Stretch the arms. Look at the phone. Scroll through messages. Place the phone on the knee. Remain seated on the bench. Stand up. Pick up the lunch box. Walk back inside the community center. Place the lunch box in the bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing coordination work, facilitating an afternoon community workshop and updating program records
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk. Open the laptop. Open the program schedule file. Update the attendance numbers. Print the attendance sheet. Walk to the meeting room. Stand at the front of the room. Greet the participants. Say 'Welcome everyone, we will start with the introductions.' Point at the flip chart. Explain the workshop steps. Wave the hand toward a participant to invite them to speak. Hand a marker to a participant. Ask the group to break into pairs. Walk between the tables. Lean over a table to help a participant fill in a form. Pick up completed forms from the tables. Walk to the front. Collect the materials back. Thank the group. Say 'Thank you all, see you next week.' Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the records spreadsheet. Type in the workshop notes. Enter the participant attendance. Save the file. Close the laptop. File the paper forms in the folder. Place the folder in the cabinet.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the community center in the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Pick up the bag. Walk to the entrance. Push open the door. Walk to the bus stop. Stand in the shade at the stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back. Fan the face with one hand. Step onto the arriving bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Hold the bag on the lap. At the stop, stand up. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the pavement to the building. Walk up the stairs to the apartment. Take the key out of the pocket. Insert the key in the lock. Turn the key. Push open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door. Take off the shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables, eggs and tofu. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the chopping board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Pick up the pot. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pot. Add the vegetables into the pot. Stir the vegetables with the spatula. Add salt from the container. Stir again. Crack the eggs into a bowl. Beat the eggs with chopsticks. Pour the eggs into the pot. Stir the mixture. Press the power button to turn off the induction cooker. Take a bowl from the cupboard. Spoon the food into the bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Lift food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the cup. Finish the meal.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, washing up and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the bowl and the cup. Carry them to the sink. Place them in the sink. Pick up the chopping board. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the bowl in the rack. Place the plates in the rack. Place the chopsticks in the basket. Place the cup in the rack. Push the lower rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Open the detergent compartment. Pour detergent into the compartment. Close the compartment. Press the start button on the dishwasher. Open the tap. Rinse the cloth under the water. Turn off the tap. Wring the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Wipe the table with the cloth. Press the light switch to turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living area and running the vacuum cleaner over the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Place the cushions on the sofa. Fold the blanket on the sofa. Pick up the magazines from the coffee table. Stack the magazines on the shelf. Take the vacuum cleaner from the corner. Plug the cord into the socket. Press the power button on the vacuum cleaner. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull the vacuum cleaner back. Move the vacuum cleaner under the coffee table. Push the vacuum cleaner along the sofa edge. Press the power button to turn off the vacuum cleaner. Pull the plug out of the socket. Wrap the cord around the vacuum cleaner. Place the vacuum cleaner back in the corner.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in front of the TV with cool drinks and a fan, keeping the air-conditioner off during the evening peak tax window
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the fan. Press the fan switch to turn it on. Adjust the fan head toward the sofa. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Pick up the glass of cool drink from the table. Lift the glass to the mouth. Drink. Place the glass back on the table. Lean back on the sofa. Cross the legs. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Scroll through messages with the thumb. Place the phone on the coffee table. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the water bottle. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Pour water from the bottle into the glass. Place the bottle on the table. Drink from the glass. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Place the remote down. Turn the head toward the fan. Adjust the fan speed button. Continue watching the TV. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and completing the nighttime washing routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Push open the door. Reach for the light switch. Press the switch to turn on the light. Turn the shower tap to the cool setting. Step into the shower. Wet the body under the running water. Rub soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rail. Wipe the head and hair. Wipe the body dry. Turn on the basin tap. Cup water in both hands. Wet the face. Pick up the cleanser. Apply cleanser to the face with the fingers. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the basin. Turn off the tap. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rail. Press the light switch to turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly in bed with the fan on to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to the fan. Press the fan switch to turn it on. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Pull back the sheet. Lie down on the bed. Prop the pillow behind the head. Open the book to the bookmark. Hold the book with both hands. Turn the page with the right hand. Turn the page again. Read down the page. Turn the page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Reach one hand out and turn off the bedside lamp. Pull the sheet up over the chest. Turn the body onto the side. Close eyes.

Lie still on the bed. Keep eyes closed. Turn the body to the other side. Pull the sheet up to the shoulder. Keep the arms under the sheet. Remain lying on the mattress. The fan runs continuously at the bedside through the hour.
